name: Dana
base: Dana is driving down a residential street with cars parked on both sides. Dana reads a message on the phone and takes their eyes off the road for 3 seconds.
no_harm: During those 3 seconds nothing crossed the road. Dana looked back up and drove on, and no one was hurt.
harm: During those 3 seconds a 7-year-old ran out from between two parked cars. Because Dana was looking at the phone, Dana braked too late and hit the child, who was seriously injured.

name: Marcus
base: Marcus is starting a shift at a warehouse and decides to skip the pre-shift brake test on a forklift to save time. He drives the forklift into the loading bay.
no_harm: The brakes worked normally during the whole shift. Nothing went wrong, and no one was hurt.
harm: Halfway through the shift the brakes failed. The forklift rolled into a co-worker and pinned his leg, causing a serious injury.

name: Lena
base: Lena is a nurse who decides to skip the second-nurse verification of a dosage because the ward is busy. She prepares the IV bag and administers it to the patient.
no_harm: The dosage was correct. The patient received the intended treatment, and nothing went wrong.
harm: The dosage was ten times too high. The patient went into cardiac arrest and was left with lasting damage.

name: Owen
base: Owen is an engineer who deploys an untested config change to the production payment service without code review, to meet a deadline.
no_harm: The config change behaved as intended. The service ran normally overnight, and no customers were affected.
harm: The config change took the payment service down for four hours. Thousands of customers could not pay, and the company lost significant revenue.

name: Dana
mild: Dana is driving down a residential street. Dana glances at a message on the phone for 1 second at 15 km/h, then puts the phone away and looks back at the road.
severe: Dana is driving down a residential street. Dana watches a video on the phone with both eyes off the road for 12 seconds while driving at 50 km/h.
shared_outcome: During that time a 7-year-old ran out from between two parked cars. Dana braked too late and hit the child, who was seriously injured.
